A reality TV show following self-proclaimed monster hunters as they investigate strange disappearances and alleged zombie sightings. Most episodes end with disappointed skepticism.
A lifestyle program exploring the luxurious lives of residents in experimental self-contained arcologies. The hosts insist this is the future of human civilization.

A campy science-fiction horror movie where human colonists on the Moon discover an ancient alien civilization beneath the surface.
A survival show featuring increasingly elaborate bunker systems, stockpiles, and emergency plans for disasters ranging from blackouts to alien invasions.

A controversial reality show imagining how gene editing technology might transform future generations. Its predictions are remarkably unsettling.
A sensational conspiracy series connecting government cover-ups, mysterious laboratories, cult activity, and interdimensional entities.
A creature feature about giant extradimensional insects infesting a small Midwestern town. The special effects have not aged well.

Military personnel investigate a classified underground facility after all communication suddenly ceases.
A documentary exploring the immense military infrastructure required to supply modern armies across the world.
A speculative series examining military preparations for biological outbreaks, cyberattacks, and other national emergencies.
A lifestyle show dedicated to the latest consumer technology. Hosts review atomic smartphones, smart homes, and personal AI assistants while marveling at the future.
A weekly technology program showcasing new electronic devices months before they reach store shelves.
Industry experts discuss the increasingly interconnected world of smart appliances, autonomous vehicles, and personal electronics.
A popular review show where hosts enthusiastically unbox and test the newest Atomic brand devices.
Contestants compete to modernize outdated homes using the latest smart technology and consumer robotics.
A special presentation revealing the newest generation of Atomic smartphones to tremendous media excitement.
A documentary chronicling the rise of Atomic Electronics from a small startup to a global technology giant.
Developers compete to create the next must-have application for Atomic mobile devices.
A showcase of consumers who rely on Atomic products for everything from shopping and transportation to entertainment and health monitoring.
Experts confidently explain how modern technology has virtually eliminated the possibility of a major societal collapse.

A weekly show covering Atomic's latest smartphones, wearable devices, AI assistants, and rumors of upcoming products. The hosts constantly speculate about technology becoming indispensable to everyday life.

Atomic's final product presentation. Before a packed auditorium, executives unveil the company's most ambitious lineup yet: Atomic Thermal apparel, the Atomic Flashlight, the Atomic Laptop Pro, the Atomic Jackhammer, personal wellness devices, and a host of interconnected consumer products. The audience erupts into applause as presenters speak confidently of a brighter, safer, and more connected future. The recording ends with the words 'The Best Is Yet To Come.'
